summary: feat(metrics): record browser_family on pairing view events
description:
Because:
- The pairing view events did not record the browser, and the
  pipeline user agent label shows iOS Firefox and Chrome as Safari.

This commit:
- Adds a browser_family extra to the five pairing view events.
- Adds getBrowserFamily(), which uses the existing UAParser.
- Sends it from the Pair/Unsupported page and DownloadFirefox container.
- Asserts the real Glean ping in pairingUnsupported.spec.ts.

Closes FXA-14796
